user.title: Connect your MyPup account
user.description: Sign in at {auth_url} (with Remember Me checked) so login.mypup.app sets a persistent session cookie, then paste your login.mypup.app Cookie header (recommended for automatic background renewal) or an access_token.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate MyPup
reauth_confirm.description: Your MyPup session expired. Sign in at {auth_url} and paste updated login.mypup.app cookies or an access_token.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Please verify the cookies or access token.

abort.already_configured: This MyPup account is already configured.
